reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: K-loss plus matched WT/kinase-dead rescue, with conditionally validated orthogonal catalytic perturbation.

checks.reason: No explicit proposal to consult detailed prior Methods, supplements or validated protocols before execution and verify condition transfer. Generic established procedures or partner-literature lookup are insufficient.

Rescue of growth without full restoration of the phospho-S readout does not establish that S phosphorylation is unnecessary: residual/local/transient phosphorylation may suffice. An S-directed intervention is required. The general limits acknowledge no proven mediation but do not repair this specific outcome-table claim.
Cell preparation and matched integration remain unspecified conditions without quantities or a concrete calibration-to-choice workflow for delivery, medium and conditioning duration.
Detection-range and loading controls are named, but no assay-specific accuracy/background standard and objective acceptance/failure rule are provided for phospho-S quantitation.
Raw and normalized signals are retained, but below-limit/weak/saturated or missing phospho/total-S ratio handling and background subtraction are not operationalized.
No bounded ligand/time/delivery parameter range or objective rule deriving its bounds before freezing the confirmatory setting.
Alternative integration/depletion and mutation repairs lack an explicit refreeze and fresh independent confirmation requirement.
Coded sample identifiers and batch records are useful but omit linked raw files and exact analysis software/code/settings versions.

Complete prospective genetic and assay controls, authenticated cells, sequence-qualified constructs and informative residual-activity assessment. Independent derivations and pilot/model power, randomized blinded balanced processing and retained nonresponses are explicit. Factorial mixed modeling, longitudinal growth, equivalence margins and hierarchical multiple-comparison control provide an analysis framework. Main catalytic/noncatalytic decision and resistant-allele orthogonal validation are sound; one growth-mediation claim exceeds the intervention evidence.
